name: Short Cut Double-Veggie Burger with Roasted Peppers, Tzatziki & Feta

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat. Once the skillet is hot, coat with nonstick cooking spray and add burger patties. Cook until warmed through and golden, about 4 minutes per side. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 spritz nonstick cooking spray
4 veggie burger patties, plant-based

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place tzatziki and feta in a small bowl. Stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup tzatziki sauce
½ (113 g) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.primary_message: To assemble the burgers, spread the bottom half of each bun with tzatziki-feta sauce, then top with veggie burger patties and roasted peppers. Close with the top half of each bun.
instructions.secondary_message: ½ (340 g) jar roasted red bell peppers

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide burgers between plates. Enjoy!
